task.title: Relics: make `workbook validate` cheaper for relics
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M61). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`workbook validate` reads relic history commit by commit, with no cache. It costs about 54 ms for each relic commit: 10.8 s for 200 relics of one commit each, and 32.5 s for one relic with 612 commits. The bounded-read change raised the Git processes per commit from 3 to 5.

## Wanted

Batch the history walk across commits, so the number of Git processes does not grow with the number of commits.

## Done when

- Validate's Git process count for relics is constant, or grows far slower than the commit count.
- The relic benchmark records the new timings.
- Every refusal validate reports today is still reported.
